slice: Pass 2: controls, linkages, wheels, brakes, drivetrain, protection
notes: Prices are as shown on the retailer page on 2026-10-14 unless another date is given. Retailer item numbers (Cycle Gear 'P...', J&P item #, UPC, Maciag SID) are NOT manufacturer part numbers and are labelled as such. Platform ids reuse pass 1 (ktm-chassis-controls-wheels.json); one new platform id is added (ktm-family-2025-linkage). Pass 1 products are not repeated; where pass 2 adds part numbers to a pass 1 item, the entry says so in caveats.
key_findings: Braktec (GasGas 2024+ MC/EX, GasGas EC 2021+, Husqvarna TE/TX/FE/FX 2022+) needs Braktec-specific levers: ARC sells BR-122 for Braktec and says its Flex lever is Brembo-only (not Braktec, Nissin or Magura); Tusk sells a Braktec lever replacing OEM A54013002044. Brembo-pattern levers (ARC BR-214, ASV EMF42303KTM from pass 1) should be treated as NOT fitting 2024+ GasGas MC.

Brake pads and oversize rotor kits are less clear: EBC FA181R (front) and MXS368 (rear) are listed by J&P for GasGas MC 2024-2027 alongside 2021-2023 Brembo years, and GBrakes 270 mm kit GBDOS220 lists GasGas MC 250F/450F 2024-2025, and Tusk sells a 270 mm kit for the Braktec MC 150 2025. That suggests the Braktec caliper uses the same pad shape and mount as the Brembo, but no manufacturer statement was found. Treat as medium, and confirm before buying.

MXA (Dec 2024) says the 2023-2024 KTM-family linkage uses larger linkage bolts than 2024.5 Factory Edition and 2025+ bikes, so 2023-24 and 2025+ linkage parts do not swap. Standard Husqvarna bikes use a different (lower) linkage ratio than KTM/GasGas.
Works Connection Pro Launch now lists KTM 2023-2027 SX/SX-F and Husqvarna 2023-2027 (Cycle Gear P366605); GasGas is listed as 125-450 2021-2027 on RevZilla without a model breakdown.
Works Connection Elite axle blocks for the 22 mm axle: 17-251 blue, 17-256 red, 17-261 black, 17-264 orange, 17-316 silver (KTM/Husqvarna 2023, 2022 FE/Rockstar; GasGas not stated).

NEW in pass 2. Linkage sub-platform: 2024.5 KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas Factory Editions and 2025+ models use smaller linkage bolts than 2023-2024, so linkage parts are not interchangeable between 2023-24 and 2025+ (MXA).

Works Connection perches: KTM-family bikes use hydraulic clutch and brake masters, so WC cable-clutch Elite perches likely do not apply (inference, not verified). WC brake pedals and shift levers for 2023+ KTM not found.
Galfer manufacturer catalogue (galferusa.com) not reached: no confirmed Galfer part numbers with KTM 2023+ fitment for rotors, oversize kits or pads. Parts Europe pages need JavaScript.

Braktec vs Brembo: lever split is confirmed (separate ARC/Tusk Braktec levers). Pad and rotor-kit compatibility is suggested by retailer fitment (EBC, GBrakes, Tusk) but no manufacturer statement; Braktec master cylinder upgrade or swap to Brembo not documented.
Brembo master cylinder upgrades (e.g. 10 mm PS 10/16 on KTM Factory Edition) found only in forum posts; no retailer SKU.
Haan, Talon/Excel, DID Dirtstar complete wheels for 22 mm axle bikes: no SKUs or fitment found. Rim locks and Pivot Works bearing kits not researched. All Balls front kit not identified.
Chains: Regina ZRT and EK not researched; stock chain link count per 2023+ model not captured.
JT front sprocket part numbers (JTF) and stock gearing per bike not captured; JT catalogue URL in search pointed to a non-KTM model.
Cycra and Acerbis handguards: no model-specific mount kits identified for tapered Neken bars.
Frame guards and pipe guards not researched.
AXP 4-stroke 2023+ and GasGas 2024+ AXP skid plates not captured.
Husqvarna 2026 FC missing from several fitment lists again (EE, Pro Launch) - likely retailer data gaps.
2025+ linkage bolt change (MXA) means pass 1 and pass 2 linkage/lowering parts listed as '2023-on' need re-checking for 2025+.
